fix_tasks.title: Hold / pop bottom strip: crisp wind-wave crests instead of a smeared, stair-stepped band (anti-aliased hero reflection, texture-filtered chop)
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: Hold-sweep MAJOR (+0.5). The bottom ~50 px of every dolly-in frame (p06 y716-766, sw_hold_L, sw_pop_B, all six hold bottoms) is a light band with a hard-ish top edge at y716-723. Its dark-blue patches have borders made of 2-8 px x 1 px horizontal stair-steps, plus speckle (p06_bot_br4x, p06_bot_bc4x, popB_steps4x, hold_bottoms.png). F420 shows smooth, curved dark-blue wind-wave crests on light water. Jury MAJOR: a milky smear with a ragged right edge and 1-2 px stair-stepped streaks at 6x. Environment: a flat dark band at p06, SD 10.8 vs F420 16.1. This item is already on the lead's round-4 list ('water bottom strip via a mipmapped wave normal texture').
fix_tasks.root_cause: In the hold (uHold -> 1) the near water 16-25 m from the camera reflects through three under-sampled layers. LK_WAVEB's crest tilt (lkWaveGrad, LK_WAVE2_N 12) and lkChop bend all three. (1) The hero reflection, RenderPipeline.reflection, is a half-size target (quality.ts reflectionScale 0.5 on T1/T2) built by makeColorTarget(w, h, false, true): no MSAA, no mips. Water.ts samples it once, texture2D(uReflection, ruv + rOffs), with rOffs taken from the bump + crest normal lkN and no footprint; the water's own spread lkSig is ignored. The mirrored arcs' half-res, un-anti-aliased coverage edge is therefore magnified into 2-px stair-steps, and neighbouring pixels flip between hero and sky. (2) The LakeMirror target is also half size on T1 (MIRROR_SCALE [0.5, 0.5]), and only the strata lookups get the LK_P4FP 1.5-texel footprint floor (lkP4Floor). (3) lkChop's analytic value-noise octaves (uLkP4CF 0.3 / 0.65 cycles/m) are band-limited by fwidth amplitude fades (uLkP4B 0.1-0.25). Its slope soft limit (uLkP4B.w 0.3) fills the steepest tilts with one flat zenith blue, which produces the hard-edged dark patches.
fix_tasks.implementation_plan: All round-4 work sits under a master switch, ?p4r4=0, that restores int2 exactly (laneSource / stripDef blocks, as in P4). 0) Diagnose before coding (lab, ~30 min). At p06, sw_hold_L and sw_pop_B, switch off one layer at a time: ?lkchop=0, ?lkwave2=0, lab ?lkmscale=1,1, a new lab switch ?herorefl=0 (uReflectionOn 0), then uLakeDebug 1 (raw reflection) and 6 (flat mirror). Per variant, count stair-step runs in y700-766: >= 3 equal pixels in a row bordered by >= 20-level jumps. Fix the dominant layer first; I expect the hero reflection, then the chop. 1) Hero reflection (?herorefl=r11 restores). Give the reflection target samples = profile.msaa (4 on T1/T2), generateMipmaps with LinearMipmapLinear, and anisotropy 8. Sample it with textureGrad using the water's footprint: the screen derivatives of ruv plus J * 3.46 * lkSig along the reflected elevation, as mirrorTex / lkReflect already do for the env mirror. Floor that footprint at 1.5 target texels while uHold > 0. Keep reflectionScale 0.5. 2) Chop from a mip-mapped texture (?lkchoptex=0 restores the noise). At load, build one 256x256 tileable RG16F slope texture holding the two current octaves (wrap REPEAT, mipmaps, anisotropy 16). In lkChop, replace noised() n1 / n2 with two textureGrad fetches: world xz * uLkP4CF.x, and the same rotated 37 deg * uLkP4CF.y, both scrolled by uLkP4CF.zw, with gradients from dFdx/dFdy(vWorldPos.xz) taken before any branch. Drop the per-octave fwidth fades, since the mip chain now band-limits; keep uLkP4D.x's chop AA. 3) Crest shape. Phase-sharpen the chop the way Q8 shaped the ring profile (Q 0.35: steep crests, broad troughs). Raise uLkP4B.w 0.3 -> 0.45. Shade the deepest tilts from the sky gradient at their own reflected elevation, not one flat zenith colour. Tune against F420 y716-766: luma SD 16 +- 2 (now 10.8), mean within +-3 levels, F420's B-R, crest bands 50-200 px wide. Gates: no >= 3-px stair-step runs in y700-766 at 4x in p06 or the six sw_hold / sw_pop frames. With the camera frozen and time running, the per-pixel frame-to-frame |dL| p99 in the strip stays within the AA8 gate. Rest frames are bit-identical (tools/ident). T1 hold frame <= +0.3 ms.
fix_tasks.risk: MSAA + mips on the half-size reflection target cost ~0.2-0.4 ms on T1. The textureGrad lookup must not soften the rest near-water hero reflection: keep the rest footprint exactly, or gate the floor on uHold. The waterline TAA's hero-reflection mask reads the same target, so the AA harness must be re-run (G1 / L4 cells). T0 is unchanged (no MSAA there, reflectionScale 0.25).
fix_tasks.expected_gain: glitch_hold_sweep +0.5, awwwards +0.1, environment +0.05 (overall +0.03). Removes the 'weird bottom of the frame' the client warned about.

fix_tasks.title: Crawling black specks, comb ticks, floe seam ticks and rock needles on sub-pixel env edges
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: Orbit-glitch MAJOR (+0.3): 2-4 near-black single pixels per pose (down to RGB 2,3,8) jump along the 1-px navy front edge of the flat ice sheet left of the sculpture: ptr_right (703,537), ptr_bottom_left (577/601,510), ptr_rest (616,536), and more (BLACKPX8x, SPECKS8x_grid). The same specks sit on the far-right floe comb and on the needles of the right foreground rock. Orbit MINOR (+0.1): a stable comb of 1-px dark ticks at ptr_rest (1281-1290, 478-483), a lone grey tick at ptr_right (951,425), needle spikes on the rock crest. Hold-sweep MINOR (+0.1): 1-px dark UV-seam ticks on the floe side faces at p06 (34-219, 634-644), sw_hold_L (1360-1379, 622-627) and sw_intro_3 (1279-1288, 478-482).
fix_tasks.root_cause: Three causes combine. (1) The baked materials interpolate 'varying vec2 vBakeUv' (PLATE_VERT, PLATE_FRAG, PLATE_MIRROR_FRAG) without centroid. Under 4x MSAA a pixel partly covered by a sliver is shaded at the pixel centre, outside the triangle, so its UV is extrapolated off the UV island. (2) samplePlate then calls textureGrad with the bake UV derivatives scaled by k = 2^lodDof * W / 1800 (lodDof = 1.5 + up to 1.6 near the camera, so k ~2.3-6.9). That selects coarse mips, where the island's 16-texel EXTEND bake margin (bake_env_m9.py margin=16, islands packed 8 texels apart, crop +4 texels, use_clear=True) has been averaged with the black cleared background. (3) The env GLB keeps sub-centimetre sliver triangles (floe pegs, rock needles, the sheet's 1-px front face). Together these give dark specks that move with the camera, and floe-seam ticks wherever mip levels cross island borders.
fix_tasks.implementation_plan: 1) Centroid UVs (?bakecentroid=0 restores): declare 'centroid varying vec2 vBakeUv' in PLATE_VERT and in both fragment programs. Three's GLSL3 prefix turns this into 'centroid out/in', which is valid ESSL 3.00; both stages must match. Also clamp the textureGrad footprint to <= 2^(lodDof + 1.5) texels, so a sliver's huge derivative cannot pick the top mips. 2) Fill the atlases (?bakefill=0 loads the old files). Add a small tools script that applies a push-pull fill to every baked .webp: build a mip pyramid of the island colours with coverage weights, then fill every empty texel from the coarsest valid level down, so no level of the GPU-generated mip chain contains black. Re-encode at the same quality as baked/*_f2.webp and load them through assets.ts. 3) Remove slivers (?envgeo=v9 restores). In a copy of env_baked.glb (Blender, never touching the sources), collapse faces < 1 cm^2 and weld floe pegs and rock needles below 1 px at 1440 into env_baked_v10.glb, keeping every silhouette within 0.5 px. 4) Guard: max(col, 0.0) and a NaN check after the card light (p4card) and on degenerate normals. Gates: speck scan (pixels darker than all 8 neighbours by > 35 luma) = 0 in all 10 ptr poses and in p06. The comb at (1281-1290, 478-483) and the p06 floe ticks are gone. q00 moves by <= 2 levels outside the edge pixels. The AA harness's waterline cells still pass.
fix_tasks.risk: Centroid shifts the derivative-based mip choice on edge pixels, and EnvEdge, aaresolve and the waterline TAA all see those pixels, so the AA harness must be re-run. Filled textures change file sizes (budget check). Welding can nudge floe silhouettes. On T0 centroid is a no-op (no MSAA), but the filled textures help T0 too.
fix_tasks.expected_gain: glitch_cursor_orbit +0.4 (specks +0.3, comb and slivers +0.1), glitch_hold_sweep +0.1. Removes crawling 'ants' along edges and seams in motion.

fix_tasks.title: Far-water blotches and corduroy: remove the orbit ghost at its source, then turn on the glassy far lake
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: Orbit-glitch MAJOR (+0.3): pale irregular 'map-outline' blotches with hard 1-px edges on far water at ptr_rest x420-560 y462-482 (adjacent-pixel jumps 182->188, 191->181). Their shape changes with the camera (ptr_left x280-420, ptr_right x522-580), so they will shimmer during the orbit (FARWATER_eng_ref3x). Environment MAJOR (+0.25): uniform horizontal 'corduroy' across the mid and far lake; floe reflections break into 20-30 px streaks where F000/F420 show long soft vertical smears. Jury MAJOR (+0.2): 3.2x the reference's high-frequency energy at (880,470). Hold-sweep MINOR: 1-px sparkle on the rest ripple field at sw_tau_1.25.
fix_tasks.root_cause: The glassy far-lake fix already exists but is off. P4 water Q9 (the per-octave alias guard uLkP4Gl, ?lkglass=1) was disabled because glassier water unmasks the 'orbit ghost'. The ghost comes from the quarter-size walk term (LK_HALF, walkDiv 4: one walk texel per 4x4 px). lkWalkRead blends it bilinearly, and where its four taps disagree it paints a blocky pale blotch. G6's per-pixel fallback (?lkwalkj=1) removed that blotch but added new waterline pop clusters, so it is off too. MAIN's corduroy (the coherent share of lkBump's sub-pixel octaves) currently hides the ghost.
fix_tasks.implementation_plan: 1) Diagnose at ptr_rest / ptr_left / ptr_right with ?lkhalf=0, ?lkwdiv=1 and 2, ?ffblock=0 and uLakeDebug 12, to confirm the blotches are walk texels and not the AA5b far-floe block. 2) Edge-aware walk upsample (?lkwalkbl=0 restores). Replace lkWalkRead's plain bilinear with a joint-bilateral weight: bilinear * exp(-|d_dist| / (0.02 dist)) * exp(-|d_a| / 0.05), where a is the horizon the walk raised (its alpha). Only where the summed weight is < 0.25 does the pixel compute its own lkWalkTerm, which is the existing LK_WALKNEAR path, a few px along waterlines. That is a far narrower fallback than G6's broad blend. 3) Turn Q9 on by default (?lkglass=0 restores MAIN's corduroy), with uLkP4Gl (0.15, 0.45, 30, 40) and the W2 gate as tuned. 4) Longer floe pillars: uLakeFar.x 0.05 -> 0.035 beyond 30 m. Check that the iceberg-face reflection at x1180-1240 y500-575 darkens toward F420. 5) Optional: extend EnvEdge's waterline TAA to every lake pixel beyond 30 m (TAA_FRAG taaKind 1), keeping today's no-history rule in the hold crest train. Gates: high-frequency energy (mean |x - blur1.5|) in the 200x90 box at (880,470) <= 1.3x F000 (now 3.2x). No pale blotch with >= 15-level 1-px edges in x280-580 y455-490 in any ptr pose. Every G1 / L4 cell of the AA harness's six paths stays inside its bar, with no new >= 6 px pop clusters. Rest water boxes stay within +-2 levels outside the far band.
fix_tasks.risk: The waterline AA gates (AA3-AA8) are fragile: any walk change must be re-gated against the 16-sample reference. The bilateral weight adds 4 fetches over the lake (~0.2 ms on T1). T0 uses the plate lake and is unaffected.

fix_tasks.title: Ice shading AA: no stair-steps, 1-px speckles, dotted rims or streaks that crawl as the rings tumble
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: Ice MAJOR (+0.3): q03 outer-ring top-left x565-640 y185-310 has a stair-stepped edge with isolated bright and dark pixels and white dotted contour lines (q03_topleft_4x, q03_crest_pair_4x). q01 inner edge x612-622 y290-400 has a 1-px bright-plus-dark double rim. p06 ring A's lower-left arc shows dotted white streaks. The q00 lower edge is zipper-like. Jury MINOR (+0.15): 1-px specular slivers, speckled inner silhouette at p04. Orbit MINOR (+0.05): chains of darker pixels along thin refraction lines (RINGSPECK6x).
fix_tasks.root_cause: The rings already render into the 4x MSAA main target on T1/T2 (quality.ts msaa 4; RenderPipeline's ring passes), so the ice lens's 'render the ice into the MSAA target' is already true. This is shading aliasing. The round-11 trace evaluates the exit wall, the critical-angle split and every thin highlight once per pixel, at its centre: the Fresnel rim, the steel-blue inner rim line (uP4F.y 1.3), the hold facet glint (uP4G.y 0.5) and the cap glint (uP4D.w 1). P4 G5's band limit (uP4A) covers the bump octaves but not these terms. At silhouettes the refracted lookup (bumpOff and the lens projection) samples across the refraction copy's depth discontinuity, so neighbouring pixels alternate between background and ice: the 1-px bright and dark speckles.
fix_tasks.implementation_plan: Switch ?iceaa2=0 restores; T1/T2 only (T0 unchanged). 1) Silhouette guard: s = smoothstep(0.08, 0.22 + 2 fwidth(NdotV), NdotV). Scale the refraction offsets (bumpOff and the copy lookups' lens offset) by s, and blend the transmitted colour toward the unbent copy as s falls. 2) Filter the thin terms: widen the smoothstep edges of the rim, the inner rim line (lk), the joint lines (jLine) and the glints by 1.5 fwidth of each term's argument, as the joint seam code already does with fX / fS. 3) Toksvig specular AA: for the trace lobes (roughT) and the glint alphas, alpha^2 += 0.5 |fwidth(N)|^2, clamped at 0.25. 4) Isolated-firefly clamp before AgX: clamp ice luma to <= its value smoothed by its own derivatives (L - 2.5 fwidth(L) bound); no neighbourhood fetch. 5) Keep the trace's corner rounding as it is (F5's crisp hold slabs). Gates: in the ring boxes (q03 565-700 x 185-310, q01 612-622 x 290-400, q00 650-800 x 515-528, p06 510-690 x 500-640), the count of pixels > 40 levels from all 8 neighbours drops to <= 25 % of today. The lane's tumble crawl metric (motion-compensated residual; the Cycles video scores 4.4-5.9) stays <= MAIN's 4.9 and should reach <= 4.5. Ring box means stay within +-2 levels at q00, q03 and p06.
fix_tasks.risk: Over-filtering makes the ice read as gel, the opposite of the ice lens's chiselled target. Keep the MSAA silhouettes crisp and filter only sub-pixel shading. The firefly clamp could dull the facet glints R4-Q3 adds, so it must apply only to isolated pixels.

fix_tasks.title: Release rejoin: no light bars or flat steps at ring-A joints while the gap closes
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: Composition MINOR (+0.1): sw_rel_T x785-820 y500-540 shows a rectangular, flat-faced step where two ring-A segments meet (relT_tab_4x). p07 ring-A joints (720-787, 227-273 and 680-720, 453-493) show light bands across the tube (p07_zoom). At rest the same joints are thin dark seams that match the reference.
fix_tasks.root_cause: Rings.update fades each piece's joined seam within the first 3 cm of opening: uPieceCuts.w = 1 - smoothstep(1e-4, 0.03, moved). IceMaterial's Q6 cap path (capK) switches on as soon as w < 0.999, with its chamfer (uP4D.z 0.04) and cap glint (uP4D.w 1). Through a 0-3 cm gap the bright, glinting cap faces therefore show as a light bar, not a dark seam.
fix_tasks.implementation_plan: Switch ?seamrel=0 restores. 1) Rings writes the joint gap in metres to a new uniform uP5Gap next to uPieceCuts. Use the ring's push (poseRigid's push * open) so both pieces of a joint switch together. 2) In IceMaterial, scale capK, the chamfer and the cap glint by smoothstep(0.015, 0.05, uP5Gap). Hold the joined V seam until the gap exceeds 1.5 cm by changing the seam fade from (1e-4, 0.03) to smoothstep(0.015, 0.05). Gates: at p07, sw_rel_T and the other sw_rel frames, no band > 30 levels above the tube's mean crosses a joint while the gap is < 4 px. Hold caps are unchanged once the gap exceeds 5 cm (p05 / p06 identical there). Rest is identical.
fix_tasks.risk: Low. The seam hand-over must not pop: 1.5-5 cm is about 2-4 frames of the close. R4-Q7 reuses the gap uniform.

fix_tasks.title: Capture harness and lab parity: holds dissolve the copy in captures; add a 60 fps press / hold / release capture
fix_tasks.evidence_summary: In all six sweep hold frames the headline is fully drawn, and the opened arcs collide with it (sw_hold_B 430-590 x 530-590, sw_hold_L 490-590 x 530-600). Without ?debug the product is bit-identical. 2) hero-lab/main.ts mirrors HeroExperience.tsx's onHoldChange (data-hero-hold toggle, Ink out/in). index.html adds data-hero-copy to .hero-copy and .scroll. 3) The capture tool waits for the ink's out() duration before shooting hold frames. Gates: no copy in sw_hold_*; ui_rest identical; production pixel-identical without ?debug.

G holds 3D Voronoi edge distance for crack sheets (cells ~0.25 m). 2) In the ice shader, sample it at vObjPos * s at two incommensurate scales and rotations.
